tool.name: force_tileextent
tool.description: Compute valid tiles for a given datacube definition and area of interest. This list can be used by downstream analysis tasks to limit processing to the area of interest when satellite data covers a larger region.

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use

tool.help:
**force_tileextent**
Compute valid tiles for a given datacube definition and area of interest. This list can be used by downstream analysis tasks to limit processing to the area of interest when satellite data covers a larger region.
**nf-core Module Information:**
- Module: force/tileextent - Container: nf-core/force:3.8.01
**Usage:** This tool provides the functionality from the nf-core module within Galaxy workflows.
